enchantments.tooltip: Quality Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Constitution.
Natural Armor +14: Passive: +14 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Hound's Blood: This artifact, while equipped, grants you some of the innate protections of a Thaarak Hound. You are warded against Charms, Poison, and Petrification.
Hound's Bones +23%: You are strengthened by the bones of a powerful Thaarak Hound. +23% Enhancement bonus to Acid and Evil Absorption.

One with the Swarm: While wearing two pieces from the One with the Swarm set, you gain: You are protected by a swarm of hostile bees that lash out when you are struck in melee range. On vorpal melee strikes, they will also swarm your enemies, dealing Piercing damage over time.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
